title: Phantom Tales of the Night
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An episodic supernatural series set at an inn (the Thundercloud or Murakumo Inn) that shelters troubled spirits and humans, run by an innkeeper of no fixed gender who takes payment in guests' deepest secrets. The first guest, a boy called Sasaki-kun, learns he has never been alive; the Innkeeper restores just enough flesh and bone for him to pass as human. Tales of yokai, ghosts and the Innkeeper's servant Butterfly explore secrets, shame and the wish to be seen (Yen Press blurb; ANN Fall 2019 Manga Guide).
life_message: Everyone carries secrets and longs to be seen; what we hide shapes what we become.
